topics.topic: DOJ dropping investigation into Jerome Powell
topics.description: The Department of Justice has dropped its investigation into Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell, likely clearing the way for Powell's potential reappointment or for Kevin Warsh to take over. This decision comes after a thorough examination of allegations surrounding Powell's actions, including concerns about the Federal Reserve's handling of certain financial matters.
